title.purpose: Login and registration form heading; 26px at 480px, 24px at 350px.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Subtle ambient clay depth on authentication cards.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Input border/shadow and primary background/shadow changes only; no movement.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width authentication action with explicit hover, press, focus, and disabled states.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:"Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;width:100%;min-height:52px;padding:14px 44px;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius-control,10px);background:var(--text, #2c2d29);color:var(--card, #ffffff);box-shadow:0 4px 8px #2c2d291c,inset 0 1px 1px #ffffff24,inset 0 -2px 3px #00000026;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,box-shadow 160ms ease-out}.ds-primary:hover{background:#42443c;box-shadow:0 6px 12px #2c2d2926,inset 0 1px 1px #ffffff24}.ds-primary:active{background:#20211d;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 4px #00000026}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--text, #2c2d29);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-primary:disabled{cursor:wait;background:#5e6056;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px #0000001a}.ds-arrow{position:absolute;right:18px;width:20px;height:20px}.ds-primary:disabled .ds-arrow{visibility:hidden}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}}@media(forced-colors:active){.ds-primary{border:1px solid ButtonText}}

components.name: Labeled Input
components.description: Persistent label, outlined field, and associated inline error region.
components.html: Enter your email address.
components.css: .ds-field{font-family:"Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;color:var(--text, #2c2d29)}.ds-label{display:block;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5}.ds-input{font-family:"Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;box-sizing:border-box;display:block;width:100%;height:50px;min-width:0;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line, #92958b);border-radius:var(--radius-control,10px);background:var(--card, #ffffff);color:var(--text, #2c2d29);font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;caret-color:var(--text, #2c2d29);box-shadow:inset 0 2px 3px #35362e05;transition:border-color 160ms ease-out,box-shadow 160ms ease-out}.ds-input::placeholder{color:#72746a;opacity:1}.ds-input:hover{border-color:#6e7167}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--text, #2c2d29);outline-offset:3px;border-color:var(--text, #2c2d29)}.ds-input[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:var(--error, #963c35)}.ds-error{margin:8px 0 0;color:var(--error, #963c35);font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-error[hidden]{display:none}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-input{transition:none}}

components.description: White, softly raised container for the shared login and registration form.
components.html:

components.name: Canvas Controls
components.description: Compact white gallery controls with dark text, at least 44px targets, and visible focus.
components.css: .ds-canvas-controls button{font:inherit}.ds-canvas-controls { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; max-width: 100%; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--canvas-border,#92958b); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--canvas-control,#ffffff); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px #2c2d2914; pointer-events: auto; }.ds-canvas-controls button { display: inline-flex; flex: 0 0 auto; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; color: var(--canvas-text,#2c2d29); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out; }.ds-canvas-controls button:hover { background: #eeeee8; }.ds-canvas-controls button:active { background: #e1e3d9; }.ds-canvas-controls .ds-canvas-playback { min-width: 80px; gap: 5px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; }.ds-canvas-controls svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }.ds-canvas-controls{font-family:"Segoe UI",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;color:var(--canvas-text,#2c2d29)}.ds-canvas-controls button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--canvas-text,#2c2d29);outline-offset:4px}.ds-canvas-divider{height:20px;width:1px;background:var(--canvas-border,#92958b)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-canvas-controls button{transition:none}}@media(forced-colors:active){.ds-canvas-controls{border:1px solid CanvasText}}

narrative.overview: Minimalist login and registration use white surfaces, warm off-white surroundings, and subtle clay lighting. Dark text keeps the forms readable. The signed-in dashboard carries the same warm off-white palette, dark captions, white controls, and a centered supplied logo behind the destination tiles.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained clay depth and curved controls.
Persistent labels, clear focus, and explicit state feedback.

rules.name: The White Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep white as the accent; do not introduce pastel highlights.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Controls change color and shadow without moving or scaling.

rules.name: The Visible State Rule
rules.body: Preserve labels, focus outlines, adjacent error text, and explicit submission feedback.

dos: Do use white surfaces, warm off-white surroundings, and dark readable text.
Do keep login and registration on the same shared component system.
Do retain compact-screen spacing, subtle clay lighting, and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't replace labels or validation text with color alone.
Don't add movement to state transitions.
